title: Jerusalem temple — symbols, commanded worship, oracles
source_text: XXVI. Similiter in templo Hierosolymitano Deus habitare olim dicebatur, quoniam ibi certa praesentiae suae symbola collocari voluerat: nempe arcam foederis, & propitiatorium. Et ibidem singulari quadam ratione se coli praeceperat, & preces sibi offerri quas promiserat se exauditurum. Imo aliquando inde viva reddebat oracula, & responsa dabat interrogantibus.
pass_a_gloss: Likewise God was once said to dwell in the temple at Jerusalem, because there He had willed certain symbols of His presence to be placed: namely the ark of the covenant, and the mercy-seat. And there by a certain singular reason He had commanded Himself to be worshiped, and prayers to be offered to Him which He had promised He would hear. Nay sometimes from thence He gave living oracles, and answers to those who asked.
pass_b_english: Temple habitation: ark and mercy-seat as presence symbols.
Commanded worship and promised hearing of prayer there.
Sometimes living oracles and answers from that place.

lemmas.gloss: the ark of the covenant, and the mercy-seat
